page.layout: One page of running text in one block. Running head centred at top, page number at top right. Signature at bottom right, below the last line. No marginal notes.

p.i: poris eius in coniunctione nobis exposita, tenebris involvatur, in oppositione autem dimidia superfi-cies eius, quam nos aspicimus, lumine solari fulgeat. Nunc etiam adiicimus hoc, quòd sol similiter illu-stret dimidiam superficiem terrae: idcirco lumen in superficie terrae renolvitur cum renolutione solis ab oriente in occidentem: eodem modo tenebrae in ea renolvuntur. Quoniam autem sol maior est terra, oportet ut umbra terrae extendatur in aere ad simi-litudinem coni, & paulatim in rotunditate minuatur atq; reddatur subtilior, donec tota deficiat, manente tamen linea perpendiculari ipsius umbrae tornatilis in superficie Zodiaci, quae opponitur gra-dui solis diametraliter. Umbrae vero longitudo, quae à superficie terrae eò usque extenditur, donec deficiat, secundùm probationem Ptolemaei aequat semi-diametros terrae ducetas & sexaginta octo: & dia-meter rotunditatis umbrae in loco transitus lunae, quo tempore opponitur soli, aequat diametrum cor-poris lunaris bis cum tribus quintis unius. Cùm ergo luna est in oppositione solis, & appropinquat capiti vel caudae draconis; nò habet latitudinem, qua egrediatur ab umbra terrae ad septentrionem vel meridiem: ideò necessariò incurrit in umbram ter-rae, quae subtrahit illi splendorem solis. ita videtur luna pati eclipsin, donec transeat umbram: siqui-dem umbra sequitur motum solis, quem cùm luna vincit, egreditur à parte orietali, quâ lumine solari

page.notes: Page is mid-sentence at the top ("poris" is the end of "corporis" from the previous page). Long s rendered as plain s throughout; the initial "f" in words such as "fulgeat" was read as printed where a crossbar was visible. Spellings "renolvuntur" and "renolvitur" are my u/v reading of "renoluuntur" and "renoluitur" and may need checking. Grave accents (quòd, cùm, nò, ideò, necessariò) kept as printed. Dark marks at the bottom left and the lower edge are stains, not text.
